wa_seagull.notes: Relation to the Gulls: Seagull is the first stem-box route, the twin cracks just left of the bolted Old Warriors arete (wa_old_warriors_never_die). Left Gull (wa_left_gull, not mine) climbs the pillar just left of the stem-box routes and shares its top anchor (2016 webbing with rap rings, a Metolius rap bolt and a piton) with Seagull and Ten-A-Cee Stemming (wa_south_face_4_ten_a_cee_stemming), so Left Gull is the usual way to set a top-rope on Seagull. Right Gull (wa_right_gull) is a separate 3-pitch line further along; Old Warriors is described as just left of "Wrong Gull", a name with no row and no MP page found (possibly MP shorthand for Right Gull). Seagull is its own line on both MP and theCrag: not a duplicate or a variation. Anchor type for Seagull itself not stated, so no anchor proposed.
